hero.title: A serene holiday retreat in El Capistrano Village
hero.description: Nestled on the slopes of the Sierra de Almijara with scenic views between the Mediterranean sea and Andalusian peaks, Casa Dali welcomes you for an unforgettable stay under the Spanish sun.

apartment.title: A lovingly renovated tranquil haven
apartment.subtitle: Modern comfort, warm Mediterranean styling, and relaxed holiday vibes.

general.desc1: Our holiday apartment was thoroughly renovated with quality materials.
general.desc2: With an area of approx. 55 m², it offers top-notch comfort for 2 persons and can accommodate up to 4 guests.
general.desc3: Full reversible air conditioning (heating & cooling) for optimal comfort all year round.

living.bed: Bright bedroom with a double bed for 2 guests.
living.sofa: Spacious living area with a comfortable double sofa bed for 2 guests.
living.tv: Flat-screen LCD TV with international channels.

kitchen.bath: Modern bathroom with a generous walk-in shower and hair dryer.
kitchen.cook: Fully equipped kitchen: ceramic cooktop, oven, microwave, large fridge-freezer, washing machine, and complete cookware.

outdoor.terrace: Spacious private terrace with retractable sun awning for al fresco dining.
outdoor.garden: Private landscaped garden filled with bougainvillea and exotic flowers, with BBQ available.

amenities.linen: Bed linens, bath and hand towels, and beach towels provided and replaced weekly.
amenities.village: Free parking, on-site restaurant, supermarkets, ATM, and local bus stopping right by the village for town and beaches.

activities.pools: Free access to Capistrano Village swimming pools and wading pools (the main pool is right in front of the apartment).
activities.sports: Tennis courts 150 m away, two golf courses within 20 km.
activities.ski: Sierra Nevada ski slopes (Granada) only 1 hour drive away.

situation.title: Nerja & El Capistrano Village
situation.subtitle: A remarkable subtropical microclimate and the timeless charm of an Andalusian white village.

capistrano.title: El Capistrano Village
capistrano.text1: El Capistrano is an exceptional village complex featuring traditional Andalusian architecture, whitewashed villas, pedestrian cobbled alleys, and blooming tropical gardens.
capistrano.text2: Famous Burriana Beach is 800 meters away, and the Balcony of Europe is 1.1 km away. Bus lines run directly through the village.

nerja.title: Nerja, Jewel of the Costa del Sol
nerja.text1: Sheltered by the Sierra de Almijara, Nerja has preserved its authentic coastal town feel away from high-rise overdevelopment.
nerja.text2: It boasts over 320 sunny days a year, dramatic cliffs, crystal clear coves, and lively tapas bars.

spots.balcon: The Balcony of Europe - Iconic lookout with breathtaking panoramic Mediterranean views.
spots.eglise: El Salvador Church - 17th century Baroque and Moorish architecture.
spots.cavana: Plaza Cavana - Shaded square perfect for sangria or coffee on outdoor terraces.
spots.rues: Historic old town streets - Boutiques, souvenir shops, and artisan ice cream.
spots.cangrejos: Plaza de los Cangrejos - Waterfront square facing Torrecilla beach.
spots.bendito: Mirador del Bendito - Scenic overlook above Burriana Beach cliffs.
spots.aqueduc: Eagle Aqueduct - Historic four-tier 19th century architectural landmark.
spots.grottes: Nerja Caves - 4 km of magnificent subterranean chambers hosting concerts.
spots.plages: Nerja Beaches - Burriana, Torrecilla, Calahonda, and Carabeo.
spots.criques: Wild Coves - Natural secluded coves and clear waters towards Maro.
